hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/bash-guard.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "BLOCKED: $f is missing, so the Bash guard cannot run. Restore it (git checkout of .claude/hooks/bash-guard.sh) before running shell commands." >&2; exit 2; }; bash "$f"
jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --select E9,F63,F7,F82 "$f"; }
